plan.title: SOTA rounding: isolation/sandboxing, REA, MCP conformance, frontier parity
plan.goal: Round off persistent/durable/proactive agent configs: one shared confinement mechanism, sandboxed REA, MCP 2026-07-28 conformance, cadence-driven frontier scanning, and validated parity with frontier multi-agent patterns.
success_criteria: DP-3 and REA run only under aq-confine with hostile-fixture proof
hybrid bridge passes conformance audit on both handshakes
frontier candidates flow scan -> backlog -> 2-lane verdict -> tracker fold without manual discovery
every adopted pattern carries a reproducible validation
